serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Hobo.Face.smile
This gotta be the worst drug trip ever. What am I even supposed to do? Just wait it out? Something like this never happened to me before, and I smoked a fair amount in my life. 
You: Whatever, man, I’m leaving.
Hobo: What? You give up?
You: What do you mean? 
Hobo: What? You don’t know? 
You: I asked you what you were doing here, and you didn’t answer.
Hobo: Just think about it.
You: What do you mea-
Huh? 
As I was saying it, a fishing rod appeared in his hand…
His fishing rod, on the other hand, can barely even be called one, it’s just a crude stick with a line attached. 
Hobo: It should be quite obvious now. We are going to duel.
You: Duel? 
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: What? You thought I’m here to give you some tips?! How convenient!
Hobo: That’s why I hate you! 
Hobo: You wanted to know why I’m here, right?! I will tell you why, you piece of shit!
Hobo: Deep down you know well that if it wasn’t for that stupid luck of yours, you would end up like me!
You: What the hell are you talking about?
Hobo: Oh, don’t give me that! You didn’t find that sexbot lying in the ditch because of your skill! 
How does he know about that?!
Wait. {{wi}}This is in my head… {{wi}}It still stressed me out…
Hobo: If it wasn’t for her, we would be street buddies! Maybe we would even eat from the same trash can?! 
You: You don’t know that! 
#Hobo.Face.smug
Hobo: What. You think a college dropout like you would find a good job in this city? In this economy?! Ha!
Hobo: You tried and you failed. You were trying for almost a year and had to beg your mommy for more money!
You: …
Hobo: That had to be embarrassing, right? Asking her of all people. Hehe~
You: Just stop…
Hobo: Should we talk about your love life next? I wonder what your ex would think about you if she knew that you have nothing going for you aside from a living doll! 
#Hobo.Face.smile
You: JUST STOP!
Hobo: Did that rile you up? Good. You and I aren’t so different, and it makes you sick. 
You: This is the worst blunt rotation ever! How do I end this?!
Hobo: There’s only one way to do it. We need to duel.
You: Whatever, let’s just do it and get it over with!
